about_the_game:
Queen's Cards is a satisfying roguelike deck-building defense game where you defend your territory using passive and active cards.

Gameplay Styles
While playing Queen's Cards, you can choose your preferred playstyle. You can strengthen your economy to plan ahead, rely on your soldiers to build your deck accordingly, prioritize tower defense, or focus more on spells.

Deck Building
Queen's Cards gives you 3 cards at the end of each wave. Additionally, a store screen opens. The cards in the store are updated after each turn. Here, you select passive cards to determine your playstyle and unlock permanent buffs. By combining these permanent buffs, you can deal incredibly satisfying damage.

Building Your Territory
Building towers and structures in your territory is a great way to defend. The game provides you with specific areas to build, and you strategically decide which builds to create in these areas.

Tower Enhancements
Some of the towers you build have skill trees. This allows you to grant unique skills to those towers. Additionally, with your passive card deck, you can equip towers with amazing skills and combos.

Economy Management
To take advantage of opportunities in the store at the end of each turn and to draw or destroy cards when you're struggling during the game, you'll need plenty of gold. Therefore, managing your economy is crucial.

Tower Types

  • Archer Tower

  • Ballista

  • Catapult

  • Firework Tower

  • Ice Tower

  • Flamethrower

  • Axe Tower

  • Cannon

  • Laser Tower

Soldier Types

  • Peasant Soldier

  • Archer

  • Crossbowman

  • Sword and Shield Warrior

  • Axe Warrior

  • Knight

  • Spearman

  • Monk

  • Mage
